bio: Light years from the clichés traditionally associated with Chinese restaurants, l’Esprit Bouddha is a modern establishment on a permanent quest for subtlety, but that hasn’t forgotten its roots for all that. Start your meal with beef gyoza, before digging into finger-licking tasty little house pancakes stuffed with crisp Peking duck, vegetables and a punchy hoisin sauce. The epitome of Asian generosity with an absolutely knockout wine list....
